record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare FIRE_FANG: Growlithe (1 star) and Arcanine (2 stars); both have maxPP 80, range 1 and no passive (catalog NONE). The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star count (table index).

dispatch.note: Direct registry entry with a dedicated file; no routing uncertainty was queued. Hisuian Growlithe/Arcanine are separate units not covered here.

record.summary: Single target. SPECIAL damage 30 / 60 / 120 / 240 by caster stars (fallback 240) FIRST, then ONE burn attempt of 2000 ms on the TARGET (not the caster, origin = caster). A zero-damage or blocked hit does not skip the burn. The burn reuses the burn guards (IMMUNITY_BURN, Rune Protect, WATER_BUBBLE), duration reductions, longer-timer rule, weather and the request-based side reactions (Guts, Well Baked, Magmarizer, Rawst). No AP / crit duration multiplier.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: requested = table value by caster stars. AP: x(1 + AP/100) (apBoost true, passed explicitly); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false).
effects.resolution: Requested = raw table value; applied = requested x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, minimum 1) in handleDamage; shields and takenDamage are resolved in handleDamage and not read by this strategy (return value unused). Blocked completely if the target is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce.

effects.scaling: Requested duration 2000 ms on the TARGET, not AP- or crit-scaled. Stored duration = 2000 after the target's reductions (Swift Swim x0.7, Hydration x0.5, Water Veil / Surge Surfer x0.3, Odd Keystone); it replaces the burn timer and origin only if longer than the remaining burn time. Not applied with IMMUNITY_BURN, Rune Protect or the WATER_BUBBLE passive. The caster is not burned.
effects.resolution: While burning the target takes TRUE damage each 1000 ms tick equal to round(5% of its max HP) with weather / item / effect multipliers (Drought x1.3 less Heat Rock, Rain x0.7, Assault Vest x0.5, duration-reduction effects as above); no tick damage with the Well Baked passive or Magmarizer. The burn is applied after the damage call and even when that damage was blocked; side effects on the burned unit (Guts, Well Baked, Magmarizer, Rawst Berry) are listed in the evidence note.

statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit (executed: AP 100 + crit still stores 2000).
statusEffects.guards: IMMUNITY_BURN, Rune Protect and WATER_BUBBLE refuse (executed). HYDRATION halves the stored time (1000); the timer and origin are replaced only if the new time exceeds the remaining burn (9000 kept, 500 replaced).
statusEffects.combatEffect: Burn ticks as a TRUE-damage stream not part of the cast damage; side reactions on application are requests: Well Baked addDefense(20), Magmarizer addSpeed(30), Guts addAttack(5), a Rawst holder eats the berry (all executed in the stand-in).

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 120 and 240 (fallback) entries are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes (Growlithe 1, Arcanine 2). The burn duration does not depend on stars. maxPP 80 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond needing a target (requiresTarget true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Recasting on a burning target only extends the burn if the new 2000 ms (after reductions) exceeds the remaining time.
record.rawVsResolved: Raw: damage 30 / 60 / 120 / 240, burn request 2000 ms on the target. Requested damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit]; applied after SPE_DEF (ceil, at least 1). Burn: requested 2000, stored after target-side reductions or none; the burn tick damage is a separate TRUE stream. The burn attempt does not depend on the damage result (Protected target: damage 0, burn 2000).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL speDef division, minimum of 1 and the protect / skydiving / magicBounce block were read here
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Whether other code reacts to a target being burnt (synergies, items) beyond Status.triggerBurn / updateBurn
unresolved: How the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (triggerBurn, handleSpecialDamage) and the real FireFangStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_E1); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in target): damage then one burn attempt (requests 30 / 60 then 2000), the burn on the target and not the caster, the Protected case (damage 0, burn applied), no AP / crit duration scaling, the guards, HYDRATION 1000, longer-timer rule, and the Well Baked / Magmarizer / Guts / Rawst reactions.
